newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - FCM TO SELL NEW SHARES IN PUBLIC OFFER.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - FCM TO SELL NEW SHARES IN PUBLIC OFFER.

text.p: Construction company FCM will issue 340,000 shares in a public offer in the first half of August, Hansa Investments said on Tuesday.
The issue forms 25 percent of the new share capital, Hansa Investments' managing director Viktor Mahhov told Reuters. The company's present share capital is 10 million kroons.
Mahhov said the price of the shares was not fixed yet. The par value of one share is 1,000 kroons.
The company will seek a listing on the Tallinn bourse after the issue, Mahhov added.
FCM's present majority shareholder is FCM Group, which is held by its management.
It had a net profit of seven million kroons and net turnover of 158 million kroons last year.
